identity_reconciliation.reason_exact_identity_not_formally_close: The NCL union-catalog record names SOAS and the same work with one-volume extent, while the Morrison chain identifies one bound RM c.41.c.1 object; however the reviewed NCL record does not expose the SOAS callmark RM c.41.c.1 or Morrison RM number 65 as an explicit crosswalk.
identity_reconciliation.extent_reconciliation: Morrison MS 80823 describes 5 vols.; the later UCL shelfmark inventory describes the identified RM c.41.c.1 as one bound item, consistent with later rebinding or changed physical organization and no longer a blocking identity contradiction.

next_gate: Seek a direct image or item-level SOAS catalog record for RM c.41.c.1 to bind the 1797 reprint at first-party item level and, if page images become available, collate the target leaf without OCR.

Continue independent early-copy search; do not use the NCL mirr0000375 1593 field as a physical-witness vote because its own note defines that year as the original publication year inferred from the preface.
Prefer physical collation of genuinely independent 1593/1594 copies over additional metadata echoes of the same original-edition date.
